specification: Task 5.5 evidence and recurrence criteria for future ontology promotion
governing_principles: Promotion is a governed scientific decision, never a frequency threshold executed automatically.
Count independent evidence-bearing study families, not repeated mentions within one paper or duplicate publication versions of one study.
A single clear source may justify paper-specific, source-local or provisional representation but not automatic corpus-global canonicalization.

Canonical promotion requires independent recurrence and/or a documented cross-paper generalizability pathway plus semantic distinctness, owner correctness, collision review, human approval and versioned change control.
Structural promotion has a higher burden than taxonomy, vocabulary, alias or relation promotion and must first satisfy the Task 5.4 X6 structural-loss test.
Contradictory, mismatched and negative evidence remains visible and is never deleted to satisfy a threshold.
External authoritative literature may establish stable semantics or generalizability but cannot create Atlas paper-level assignments without paper-scoped Atlas evidence.
No promotion can violate Task 1.3 R1–R48, Task 1.4 X1–X9, Task 1.5 H1–H11, or locked v0.7 no-merge boundaries.

promotion_evidence_unit.name: Promotion Evidence Unit
promotion_evidence_unit.definition: One deduplicated study-family-scoped, evidence-backed support instance for one candidate meaning or relation after repeated mentions and duplicate publication versions of the same underlying study are collapsed for recurrence counting.
counting_rules: At most one positive recurrence count per independent study family for the same candidate meaning and promotion question.
Multiple experiments/components within one paper may prove multiplicity or structural severity but do not become multiple independent recurrence counts.

Preprint, conference and journal versions of substantially the same study count as one study family unless they contain independently evidenced scientific developments material to the promotion question.
A review that only repeats a cited primary-study claim does not add an independent primary recurrence count.

A review or standard may contribute external/generalizability evidence when it explicitly defines or independently synthesizes the concept; that role is recorded separately from Atlas primary-paper recurrence.
Paper identity, source role, scope and evidence lineage must remain explicit.

positive_eligibility.evidence_locator: as precise as available; never invented
positive_eligibility.source_role: must be appropriate to the promotion question and preserved

universal_promotion_gates.name: owner_correctness
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Identify the single scientific owner. A new term/value/relation/structure cannot be promoted into the wrong owner for implementation or UI convenience.

universal_promotion_gates.name: definition_and_distinctness
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Candidate definition must be precise enough to distinguish neighboring concepts and preserve Task 1.3 no-merge boundaries.

universal_promotion_gates.name: evidence_traceability
universal_promotion_gates.rule: All positive PEUs require traceable verified evidence, source role and scope; raw evidence remains immutable.

universal_promotion_gates.name: independence_audit
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Deduplicate repeated mentions and publication versions; report independent study-family count separately from raw occurrence count.

universal_promotion_gates.name: collision_and_counterevidence
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Search known collisions, incompatible meanings, negative/counterevidence and authoritative conflicting taxonomies; retain them explicitly.

universal_promotion_gates.name: analytical_or_scientific_utility
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Promotion must improve scientifically valid normalization, interpretation, querying or linking; mere visibility or popularity is insufficient.

universal_promotion_gates.name: human_scientific_review
universal_promotion_gates.rule: A human scientific reviewer must approve the promotion decision and its scope. AI/extractor proposals cannot self-promote.

universal_promotion_gates.name: version_and_history
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Approved changes enter only through the correct candidate future ontology version with changelog, prior-state preservation and explicit effective version.

universal_promotion_gates.name: migration_and_regression
universal_promotion_gates.rule: If linked normalized records or structure change, define migration and rerun applicable 36-paper, sentinel, no-merge, evidence, crosswalk and dependent-contract regression before lock/promotion.

universal_promotion_gates.name: no_automatic_threshold_action
universal_promotion_gates.rule: Meeting a numeric recurrence minimum makes a candidate eligible for governed review; it never automatically makes the candidate canonical.

promotion_classes.label: canonical_taxonomy_term_or_global_hierarchy
promotion_classes.scope: provisional/paper-specific concept to canonical term, or global is_a/parent placement

generalizability_path.external_semantic_support: either one formal/consensus standard plus one independent peer-reviewed source, or two independent peer-reviewed taxonomy/review/method sources

additional_gates: candidate is scientifically distinct and not merely alternate wording
global hierarchy requires semantic entailment, not co-occurrence or source-specific taxonomy preference
known authoritative hierarchy disagreement blocks forced global is_a and may require source-local or related-concept representation
no unresolved collision that would make one canonical meaning unsafe

promotion_classes.label: alias_scope_promotion
promotion_classes.source_local_rule: One explicit source may justify a source-local or author-defined alias when equivalence is directly evidenced in that scope.
additional_gates: equivalence must concern meaning, not only spelling/case/hyphen similarity
all known high-risk homographs/case-sensitive collisions remain scoped
a corpus-global alias is blocked if any unresolved incompatible meaning remains

promotion_classes.label: controlled_vocabulary_value
promotion_classes.scope: other-explicit/provisional/scoped value to canonical controlled value in an existing owner

generalizability_path.external_semantic_support: one formal/consensus standard or two independent peer-reviewed sources defining a stable general value

additional_gates: existing field/entity is already the correct scientific owner
value has an operational definition and is not a proxy for another dimension
adding the value does not silently broaden field meaning

promotion_classes.label: canonical_relation_type_or_relation_generalization
promotion_classes.scope: provisional relation to canonical relation type, or governed broadening of an existing relation domain
additional_gates: direction, source class, target class and semantic meaning are consistent across supporting PEUs
material context remains instance-scoped; promotion of a relation type never creates a context-free universal assertion
performance, superiority, causality, mitigation and improvement remain paper/test-case scoped
broadening an existing relation domain requires at least one adversarial/negative boundary sentinel in addition to positive recurrence

promotion_classes.label: schema_field_entity_or_generalization
promotion_classes.scope: Task 5.4 structural watch or new X6 candidate to a candidate future-version structural change

trigger_paths.name: single_case_severity
trigger_paths.criterion: One adversarial verified paper demonstrates that current structure cannot preserve a mandatory Task 1.3 distinction, evidence/provenance, stable identity, required multiplicity or scientifically necessary linkage without information loss.

trigger_paths.name: independent_recurrence
trigger_paths.criterion: The same irreducible X6 deficiency recurs in at least two independent paper study families and cannot be reconstructed through existing fields, repeatable records, taxonomy, scoped aliases, typed relations, evidence locators or synthesis objects.

promotion_requirements_after_trigger: Task 5.4 structural-home-first test is re-run and documented
irreducible loss/ambiguity/linking failure is demonstrated, not merely better queryability
minimal additive/backward-compatible structure is preferred where scientifically sufficient
migration is lossless and does not rewrite raw evidence
active major structural gaps are resolved by the candidate design

36-paper regression, applicable targeted sentinels, A6 migration/no-merge/evidence checks, 31-field/four-framework crosswalk and dependent architecture/profile contracts are rerun as applicable before promotion
candidate future ontology version is explicitly approved and locked

promotion_classes.label: merge_reparent_deprecate_or_semantic_refactor
promotion_classes.scope: change to an existing canonical term, hierarchy, alias target or relation meaning
promotion_classes.decision_basis: semantic correction/equivalence/entailment evidence and affected-record audit rather than popularity
additional_gates: full collision/no-merge audit
no unresolved incompatible usages for a global merge
all affected normalized records inventoried
old IDs/labels/history remain resolvable
replacement/re-parent rationale is explicit
migration is lossless or explicitly scoped; rollback path exists
regression suite covers previous and new semantics

structural_watch_criteria.current_treatment: D2 dynamic representation/objective taxonomy plus model/component relations
structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Verified evidence must show latent objects with scientifically distinct role/objective/provenance whose identities or links cannot be preserved by current configuration, evidence scope and dynamic relations.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT: one hard single-case semantic/identity/provenance failure or the same irreducible deficiency in at least two independent study families.

structural_watch_criteria.candidate: stable learned-model/component identity and role structure
structural_watch_criteria.current_treatment: D2 composition taxonomy plus typed component-role relations and scope/evidence
structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Distinct learned components must require stable cross-record links to architecture, configuration, inputs/outputs, training, role or evidence, with current scope/context representation demonstrably ambiguous or lossy.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; multiple components inside one paper may prove severity/multiplicity failure but count as one independent recurrence unit.

structural_watch_criteria.current_treatment: D2 temporal-decomposition taxonomy plus decomposition/training/parallel/transfer relations
structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Temporal windows/segments require stable boundaries, ordering, interfaces/transfers or segment-specific attributes not reconstructable from current records and evidence.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; otherwise remain dynamic even if temporally decomposed methods recur.

structural_watch_criteria.current_treatment: D2 learning-paradigm taxonomy plus participant/topology/aggregation/partition relations; parallel_execution remains separate
structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Repeatable participant/data-owner/topology/aggregation identities must be scientifically necessary and current contextual relations must fail to preserve them without ambiguity.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; recurrence of the word federated alone is not structural evidence.

structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Formulation-specific repeatable attributes or component-level links must materially change interpretation and be unreconstructable through taxonomy, relations and evidence scope.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; simple recurrence of strong/weak/variational labels remains PR-TAX/PR-REL territory, not schema promotion.

structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Recurring decomposition attributes/linkages must be scientifically necessary and unreconstructable from method terms, parallel_execution, network configuration, relations and evidence.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; preserves the v0.6/v0.7 defer/monitor decision until X6 evidence exists.

structural_watch_criteria.current_treatment: D2 transfer/adaptation/meta-learning taxonomy plus source/target/task/model/training relations
structural_watch_criteria.promotion_evidence_needed: Multiple transfer/adaptation events must require separately stable source, target, stage, model, domain/task and evidence linkage, with current relation/context representation demonstrably ambiguous or lossy.
structural_watch_criteria.threshold_rule: Use PR-STRUCT; multiple events in one paper can establish severity but do not inflate independent recurrence.

candidate_promotion_packet: positive PEU table with paper/study-family identities and evidence IDs/locators
raw occurrence count reported separately from independent PEU count
migration and backward-compatibility plan if applicable
candidate ontology version and changelog entry if approved
anti_gaming_rules: Do not split one paper into multiple PEUs merely because it contains multiple mentions.
Do not count duplicate/preprint/journal versions of one study as independent recurrence without independently material scientific content.
Do not count review repetition of cited primary claims as independent primary recurrence.
Do not suppress collisions, mismatches, negative results or unresolved states to satisfy thresholds.
Do not promote because a term appears in an external taxonomy if Atlas evidence does not require or use it.
Do not infer unreported classifications retroactively after a term or field becomes available.
Do not convert page/filter demand into scientific structural need.
Do not use raw frequency, citation count or popularity as a substitute for semantic evidence.

required_before_lock: correct owner document/registry updated only in candidate version
migration specification complete where records change
applicable regression and sentinel suites pass
no unresolved major structural gap created by the change

task_5_5_conclusion.next_roadmap_task: Task 6 — Define the complete Cross-Paper Intelligence system
